_doc: Hand-placed points on the paperdoll body frames (assets/sprites/characters/hero.png, in pixels of a frame_size frame from the top-left, facing right) that tools/art/paperdoll_layers.py can't find by itself. weapon: [x, y, angle] = the fist holding the weapon and the way a sword in it points (degrees clockwise from pointing right; 90 is straight down); omit it and the weapon goes on his back (back views, sit) or is put away. weapon_behind: true when that fist is on the far side of his body, so the weapon draws behind him. shield: [x, y] = the off hand, where the shield goes (on his arm, or on his back while climbing); omit it to hide the shield. front: "shield" on frames where the shield point's hand is the one nearest us (Cory 2026-10-12: weapons are always held in the front hand), so the arm (the weapon fist) is there and the shield goes on the weapon point's hand instead. head_tilt: how far the head is turned (degrees clockwise), 0 when upright. arm and holds: every weapon kind is held in his front fist (arm) at one angle to his forearm on every frame (holds); see their own _doc. hands: [[x, y], ...] = the middle of each hand his gloves go on, on frames where the hands aren't the weapon fist and the shield point (back views, sit, lying down). Preview with python3 tools/art/paperdoll_layers.py --preview.

arm._doc: His front hand on every frame he holds a weapon (the one nearest us, Cory 2026-10-12: the weapon point on idle, walk1 and walk3, the shield hand on walk2, walk4, hurt, jump and crouch, the hand on his knee when he sits, his hand when he lies fainted) and the way his forearm points there, elbow to fist, set by eye on the body frame: [x, y, angle]. On idle3 and hit his fist is raised before his chest, a little further out than the weapon point (which is on his wrist there). Every weapon kind is held in this fist at its own one angle to this forearm (holds), so no weapon moves or turns in his hand from one picture to the next. Climbing and levelup have none: no weapon in hand.

holds._doc: How each weapon kind sits in the fist the arm gives: one offset, degrees clockwise from his forearm's direction to the way the weapon points (its art is measured and straightened first), the same on every frame; behind lists frames where it draws behind him (so it never crosses his face). Nothing else per frame (tools/art/paperdoll/weapons.py holds() refuses it; tests/unit/hero_pose_test.gd checks it).

sword._doc: Gripped by the hilt, the blade 80 degrees above his forearm (Cory 2026-10-12). On hit and hurt his fists come up before his chest, so it draws behind him there instead of across his face.

wand._doc: Gripped like a sword, 80 degrees above his forearm; behind him on hit and hurt so it doesn't cross his face.

claw._doc: Worn like a big glove over his fist, pointing the way his forearm does (Cory 2026-10-11, 2026-10-12).

knuckle._doc: Worn over his fist, pointing the way his forearm does.

bow._doc: Held by the middle of its riser, lying across his forearm 5 degrees above it (Cory 2026-10-12). On hit and hurt his fists come up before his chest, so it draws behind him there instead of across his face.

staff._doc: Gripped in the middle of the shaft, 85 degrees above his forearm (Cory 2026-10-12). Behind him on hit and hurt so it doesn't cross his face.

gun._doc: Held like a pistol: the grip in his fist and the barrel along his forearm (Cory 2026-10-11), in front of him on every frame (behind him it would no longer be in his hand).
